description.value: When a red mage selects this talent, he must select one spell from the black or white mage spell list that is of a red mage spell level he can cast. He adds this spell to his list of red mage spells known as a red mage spell of its black or white mage spell level. He can instead select two spells to add in this way, but both must be at least one level lower than the highest-level red mage spell he can cast. A red mage can select this ruby talent more than once.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Talents)
